summary: Bullish (NYSE: BLSH) filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, announcing that Siris affiliate will acquire non-core Equiniti business lines: EQ Retirement Solutions, EQ Customer Resolutions, and Lenvi. The carve-out occurs in parallel with Bullish's previously announced $4.2 billion acquisition of Equiniti, expected to close January 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and definitive documents. Bullish received competition clearances from the UK, US, and Germany for the Equiniti buy. Terms include implied price that excludes non-core business results from transaction disclosures. No per-share price, premium, or advisor named. Watch for definitive agreements and remaining regulatory nods; risk-arb centers on deal timing and separation mechanics.
